acceptance_conditions.requirement: Every frozen input hash matches before and after audit.
TDA-001 through TDA-006 each remain closed under the frozen technical scope and realization contracts.
Every material claim has exact claim-owned citation support; unknown and misleading cement allocations are zero.
All mandatory scope, condition, dependency, named-case, numeric, modality, and linked-consequence facts remain visible and unambiguous.
The frozen preferred terminology map is followed and unresolved terms obey the original-language fallback contract.
Book Style v1 hierarchy, ordering, paragraph, fragment, note-label, redundancy, and connective rules all pass.
Draft Validator v1.2 remains ACCEPT with an empty failure histogram.
No accepted-draft rewrite, retrieval, generation, repair, post-render model pass, release, commit, or push occurs.

verdict_rule.GO: All acceptance conditions pass and no blocking finding remains.
verdict_rule.NO_GO: Any acceptance condition fails or any blocking finding remains.
